caseNameFull: WESTSIDE LIQUOR CO. v. KIRBY, DIRECTOR, DEPARTMENT OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGE CONTROL OF CALIFORNIA
attorneys: Harold Easton for appellant., Thomas C. Lynch, Attorney General of California, and Lynn Henry Johnson, Deputy Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
